title.en: Secret Society of the Magic-Sealed City
title.fr: Société de la ville du sceau démoniaque

1.overview: Leonard Watch, an ordinary aspiring reporter, moves to Jerusalem's Lot, a city created by the intersection of worlds where New York City once stood, and through a series of lucky coincidences, is recruited into the secret society named "Libra."
1.summary:
Leonardo Watch is a young man whose special power, the "All Seeing Eyes" catches the attention of Libra, a special organization that enforces order on Hellsalem`s Lot, a region of New York where all sort of supernatural beings coexist with humans.
Source: Wikipedia

title.ja: 幻のゴーストワゴンを追え
title.fr: À la poursuite du mystérieux camion fantôme
title.x-jat: Maboroshi no Ghost Wagon o Oe

2.overview: While Zapp makes Leo's daytime job delivering pizzas a living hell, they spot a dry cleaning van that is more than it appears to be. When Leo is kidnapped, the rest of the Libra team must work together to rescue him from his captors.
2.summary:
Some monsters involved in a shady business kidnap Leonardo once he figures them out with his power and his friends from Libra run against time to save him. 
Source: Wikipedia

3.overview: When the president is attacked by a man under the influence of a powerful synthetic drug called Angel Scale, Klaus and K.K. travel to the alterworld to challenge a Beyondian big wheel to a game of Prosfair in order to uncover the source of the drug.
3.summary:
A dangerous drug appears in the streets and to stop it from being distributed, Klaus von Reinhertz, the leader of Libra, bets his own life in a long game against an unbeatable opponent. Meanwhile, Leonardo meets and befriends White, a beautiful and enigmatic girl. 
Source: Wikipedia

4.overview: The members of Libra discover, thanks to Leo's power, that vampires appeared in the city and the vampire hunter Blitz "Lucky" Abrahms arrives to assist them.
4.summary:
The members of Libra discover, thanks to Leo`s power, that vampires appeared in the city and the vampire hunter Blitz "Lucky" Abrahms arrives to assist them. 
Source: Wikipedia

title.ja: 震撃の血槌[ブラッドハンマー]

5.overview: Aligura, the Queen of Monomania, is on the hunt to find her creation, Brody & Hummer, and her monster truck is tearing up anything that gets in her way! Meanwhile, Femt and the King of Despair make some secret plans of their own.
5.summary:
Aligula, best known as the "Queen of Monomania", starts a rampage through the city seeking the object of her desire, Dog Hummer, whose body she fused with another crush of hers, Deldro Brody into a single being. While Leo is being captive by Aligula, the members of Libra seek Dog and Deldro`s help to stop her. 
Source: Wikipedia

title.ja: Don`t forget to don`t forget me
title.en: Don`t Forget to Don`t Forget Me
title.fr: N`oublie pas de ne pas m`oublier
title.x-jat: Don`t Forget to Don`t Forget Me

6.overview: While out buying lunch for Zapp and himself, Leo befriends a mushroom-like Beyondian named Nej, who has a craving for hamburgers, but is unable to buy them from the segregated 42nd Street quarter where they are sold.
6.summary:
Leo meets a mushroom-like alien named Amagranoff Luozontam Ouv Lee Nej and the two become friends, usually eating hamburgers together, until a duo of thugs decide to make a quick buck using Nej`s secret power, drawing them to trouble. 
Source: Wikipedia

7.overview: Chasing down a rescue request from Zapp, Klaus and Leo find themselves in an underground cage-fighting arena, with Klaus winding up in the ring. Black and Leo hit it off over lunch at the diner, and learn that they have much in common.
7.summary:
After failing to beat Klaus in a fight multiple times, a fed-up Zapp tricks Klaus into thinking he was kidnapped by an underground fighting ring so he would sign up to fight. Klaus enters while Leo tags along, but the two get more than they bargained for after Leo discovers the ringmaster is an Elder Blood in disguise. 
Source: Wikipedia

title.fr: Le Jour le plus long de Z, 1re partie

8.overview: As Zapp's profligate lifestyle starts catching up with him, word comes in that a Blood Breed attack is coming to Hellsalem's Lot, but that someone outside of Libra is also involved. Black speaks to White about their relationship with Leo.
8.summary:
Zapp has spent his days leisurely until a Blood Breed appears at the city and he is tasked by his master to seal it off. 
Source: Wikipedia

title.fr: Le Jour le plus long de Z, 2e partie

9.overview: While a crowd looks on, an airplane attempting to fly into Hellsalem's Lot carries Jugei's junior pupil--and the top half of the Blood Breed Libra was fighting! The King of Despair continues setting his plan in motion. The Libra team gains a new member.
9.summary:
"Blood Battle God" Raju Jugei Shizuyoshi, founder of the Big Dipper Style Blood Technique and Zapp`s master brings in a new pupil of his to help with the Elder Blood threat in Hellsalem`s Lot. 
Source: Wikipedia

title.ja: ラン! ランチ!! ラン!!! / to the end.
title.en: Run! Lunch!! Run!!! / To the End.
title.fr: Run! Lunch!! Run!!! / To the End.
title.x-jat: Run! Lunch!! Run!!! / To the End.

10.overview: Zapp, Leo, and Zed embark upon a quest to find an agreeable restaurant at which to have lunch. Klaus, Starphase, and Abrams meet with the League of High Order Spirituals to confer about their concerns pertaining to the barrier surrounding the city.
10.summary:
Leo, Zapp and Zed`s lunch time turn to the bizarre when they come into several restaurants, one weirder than the other, until they are dragged to a heated battle along Klaus and Steven. Afterwards, Leo is cornered by the King of Despair and White, who want to use him their own, personal reasons. 
Source: Wikipedia

11.overview: Growing up on their parents' ranch, White struggles with being the only member of her family without the gift of psychic abilities, while Black is reluctant to stick up for himself and develop his own powers to their fullest.
11.summary:
As the origins of White and her brother are revealed, the King of Despair uses the power of Leo`s eyes to ignite a huge catastrophe on Hellsalem`s Lot during Halloween. 
Source: Wikipedia

12.overview: The members of Libra gather to defend Leo as he rushes to reach the King of Despair in order to confront him, not only for Black and White's sake, but to save the city as well.
12.summary:
The members of Libra gather to defend Leo as he rushes to reach the King of Despair in order to confront him, not only for Black and White`s sake, but to save the city as well. 
Source: Wikipedia

title.ja: それさえも最低で最高な日々
title.en: Even These Are the Worst and the Best Days Ever
title.fr: Nos plus belles et nos plus sales journées
title.x-jat: Sore Sae mo Saitei de Saikou na Hibi

S1.summary: A nervous Leo calls into a radio advice column show and reflects on his time spent in Hellsalem`s Lot, his dealings with his co-workers, and his interactions with Black and White up to this point.

S2.overview: The members of Libra gather to defend Leo as he rushes to reach the King of Despair in order to confront him, not only for Black and White's sake, but to save the city as well.
S2.summary:
Yuuma Uchida narrated the episode and reintroduced the characters. 
The episode also contained:
- interview with Rikiya Koyama (Klaus) and Daisuke Sakaguchi (Leonardo) voice actors
- interview with Taisei Iwasaki music composer
- interview with Unison Square Garden, the band singing the ED
- the full OP song in an official AMV format
